name: arte*
mood: farmers market poster meets catalog drop
summary: A warm food-market commerce style with black-bean dark panels, tomato red serif display type, cream and eggshell catalog surfaces, olive and mint produce accents, yellow sticker badges, rounded product cards, pill CTAs, and a modern sans utility layer.

layout.model: dark poster hero, cream catalog sections, rounded product grids, editorial splits, sticker badges, and dark footer

elevation.shadows: mostly flat; optional small offset poster shadow on stickers only
elevation.depth: color blocking, rounded crops, sticker layering, and product photography

dos: Use Miniature or a characterful serif for large emotional text.
Use Satoshi or a clean sans for practical UI and body copy.
Use Cream and Eggshell as the main catalog paper surfaces.
Use Salsa red for brand emphasis, CTAs, and selected headlines.
Use rounded cards, pill controls, and sticker-like badge moments.
Use real food, produce, packaging, or market imagery.
donts: Do not make the interface cold, blue, or techy.
Do not use glassmorphism or purple gradients.
Do not make cards sharp and sterile.
Do not overuse stickers until the grid feels chaotic.
Do not replace food imagery with generic corporate stock.
